payload.summary: MAR-2919: ENCEPHALON_DEBUG=1 makes the CLI append util.inspect output (stack, details and cause chain, depth 8) to stderr after the JSON error.
rationale: INTERNAL_ERROR deliberately hides causes in normal CLI output, which left bug reports with nothing actionable.
rules: Default CLI output stays one safe JSON value; the diagnostic is opt-in, may include local paths and is not a consumer contract.
The library API never reads the variable or prints.

searchText: ENCEPHALON_DEBUG debug diagnostics internal error cause chain stack stderr CLI
subject: cli.debug-diagnostics
